instruction: I'm working on time series forecasting and need help setting up the environment for the Prophet library. Please clone the repository from "https://github.com/facebook/prophet" to /home/user and configure it. Refer to the installation instructions at https://facebook.github.io/prophet/docs/installation.html for guidance.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting up Prophet time series forecasting library environment and verifying successful import. Similar difficulty to original - involves cloning repository, installing dependencies including Stan compiler, and import verification. Uses existing check_include_exclude metric.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if import succeeds without errors, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies Python import success by checking stderr output
get_vm_command_error extracts stderr from 'python -c "from prophet import Prophet;"' command
check_include_exclude with include=[] and comprehensive exclude list correctly distinguishes success from failure
Successful import produces empty stderr, which passes check (no excluded terms present)
Failed imports contain at least one excluded term: ModuleNotFoundError, ImportError, Traceback, Error, Exception, Failed, etc.
Exclude list comprehensively covers all common Python import error patterns
Logic is semantically correct: empty stderr = success (returns 1.0), any error keyword in stderr = failure (returns 0.0)
